name: news-verifier
description: Gathers evidence to judge whether Yahoo TW news or a claim is credible, using Yahoo News coverage, Cofacts and Google Fact Check.
long_description: Give it a tw.news.yahoo.com article URL or a free-text claim (e.g. a LINE forward). It returns the article and its original publisher, related coverage from other outlets, and matching fact-checks from Cofacts and (optionally) Google Fact Check Tools, plus a rubric so the AI can answer SUPPORTED / DISPUTED / UNVERIFIED with citations.

google_factcheck_api_key.title: Google Fact Check API key (optional)
google_factcheck_api_key.description: Enables Google Fact Check Tools (TFC, MyGoPen, AFP, ...). Leave empty to use Cofacts only.
